verdict.rationale: Alma's pricing page lists flat legal-fee line items (e.g., H-1B Change of Employer $3,000, O-1 $5,000, I-539 dependent $700) and claims 'no hidden costs.' However, no evidence shows the pricing pages break out USCIS filing fees or premium processing fees separately from Alma's own fees, or state whether those government fees are included. Flat-fee transparency is an adjacent claim, not the fee separation this story requires.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest
